features.name: Divine Spellcasting
features.summary: Prepare and cast divine Druid spells using Wisdom.

features.name: Nature Bond
features.summary: Bond with an animal companion or choose a nature domain.

features.name: Animal Companion Choice
features.summary: If Animal Companion was chosen for Nature Bond, select the companion creature.
features.scaling: effective Druid level equals Druid level

features.name: Nature Domain
features.summary: If Nature Domain was chosen for Nature Bond, select Air, Animal, Earth, Fire, Plant, Water, or Weather.

features.name: 1st-level Domain Spell Slot
features.summary: Prepare the 1st-level spell from the selected nature domain in a dedicated domain slot.

features.name: Nature Sense
features.summary: Gain +2 on Knowledge (nature) and Survival checks.

features.name: Orisons
features.summary: Prepare 0-level Druid spells and cast prepared orisons without expending them.

features.name: Spontaneous Casting
features.summary: Convert a prepared spell into summon nature's ally of the same level or lower.

features.name: Wild Empathy
features.summary: Influence animals using Druid level plus Charisma modifier.

features.name: Woodland Stride
features.summary: Move through natural undergrowth at normal speed without harm.

features.name: Trackless Step
features.summary: Leave no trail in natural surroundings unless desired.

features.name: 2nd-level Domain Spell Slot
features.summary: Prepare the 2nd-level spell from the selected nature domain in a dedicated domain slot.

features.name: Resist Nature's Lure
features.summary: Gain +4 on saves against fey abilities and effects that target plants.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.summary: Assume a familiar Small or Medium animal form as beast shape I.

features.name: 3rd-level Domain Spell Slot
features.summary: Prepare the 3rd-level spell from the selected nature domain in a dedicated domain slot.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.summary: Gain a second daily use and unlock Large or Tiny animals and Small elementals.
features.scaling: 2 uses; beast shape II or elemental body I

features.name: 4th-level Domain Spell Slot
features.summary: Prepare the 4th-level spell from the selected nature domain in a dedicated domain slot.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.summary: Gain a third daily use and unlock Huge or Diminutive animals, Medium elementals, and plant forms.
features.scaling: 3 uses; beast shape III, elemental body II, or plant shape I

features.name: Venom Immunity
features.summary: Become immune to all poisons.

features.name: 5th-level Domain Spell Slot
features.summary: Prepare the 5th-level spell from the selected nature domain in a dedicated domain slot.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.summary: Gain a fourth daily use and unlock Large elemental and plant forms.
features.scaling: 4 uses; elemental body III or plant shape II

features.name: 6th-level Domain Spell Slot
features.summary: Prepare the 6th-level spell from the selected nature domain in a dedicated domain slot.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.summary: Gain a fifth daily use and unlock Huge elemental and plant forms.
features.scaling: 5 uses; elemental body IV or plant shape III

features.name: A Thousand Faces
features.summary: Alter your appearance at will while in your normal form.

features.name: 7th-level Domain Spell Slot
features.summary: Prepare the 7th-level spell from the selected nature domain in a dedicated domain slot.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.summary: Gain a sixth daily use of Wild Shape.

features.name: Timeless Body
features.summary: No longer suffer ability penalties from aging and cannot be magically aged.

features.name: 8th-level Domain Spell Slot
features.summary: Prepare the 8th-level spell from the selected nature domain in a dedicated domain slot.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.summary: Gain a seventh daily use of Wild Shape.

features.name: 9th-level Domain Spell Slot
features.summary: Prepare the 9th-level spell from the selected nature domain in a dedicated domain slot.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.summary: Gain an eighth daily use of Wild Shape.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.summary: Use Wild Shape without a daily limit.
